audience: multi-location businesses that read customer reviews in Kiyoh

useCases.title: Check the ratings of each location
useCases.text: List the review locations with their rating statistics. Send a date to list only the locations with reviews created after it.

useCases.title: Read the latest reviews of one location
useCases.text: List the locations to find the location id. Then list all reviews of that location, with the rating and review text.

useCases.title: Find the reviews that mention a topic
useCases.text: List all reviews of one location. Then pick out the reviews that mention a topic, such as delivery delays.
